steps: Click Delete button in confirmation modal

bugs.expected_behavior: DELETE /api/files/file-a-txt returns 200 OK and permanently deletes the file from the database.
bugs.actual_behavior: Optimistic UI removes A.txt from list, but DELETE /api/files/file-a-txt returns 500 Internal Server Error. File remains in storage and reappears upon list reload/refetch.
bugs.verification_method: Execute delete on A.txt -> Observe 500 in network -> Refetch files -> Verify A.txt is still present.

bugs.error_name: 멱등성 위반 (Duplicate Folder on Double Click)

steps: Click Create button rapidly twice / double-click

bugs.expected_behavior: Only 1 folder is created due to debouncing or idempotency checks.
bugs.actual_behavior: Two POST /api/folders requests are fired and both return 201 Created. Two identical folders are rendered in DOM.

dom.element: Two folder cards with identical names

bugs.verification_method: Perform double-click on Create folder -> Verify 2x 201 responses -> Verify 2 duplicate folder elements in DOM.

bugs.error_name: 비즈니스 참조 무결성 파괴 (Wrong Target Mutation)
bugs.expected_behavior: A.txt is renamed to A_final.txt, and B.txt remains unchanged.
bugs.actual_behavior: Frontend index/reference error causes target ID to resolve to B.txt. PATCH /api/files/file-b-txt is sent. A.txt remains unchanged, and B.txt becomes A_final.txt.
bugs.verification_method: Rename A.txt to A_final.txt -> Inspect DOM -> Verify A.txt still exists and B.txt became A_final.txt.

bugs.expected_behavior: The full 47-character name is saved and displayed.
bugs.actual_behavior: Backend storage truncates name to 30 characters (Quarterly_Project_Review_Docum) and returns 200 OK. UI displays truncated string.
bugs.verification_method: Rename with >30 char string -> Check returned name in API/DOM -> Verify truncation to 30 chars.

bugs.error_name: 부분적 롤백에 따른 UI-서버 불일치 (Silent Move Failure)
bugs.expected_behavior: PUT /api/files/file-a-txt/move succeeds (200 OK) and file parent folder is updated to Archive on server and UI.
bugs.actual_behavior: Backend returns 500 Internal Server Error, but frontend silently ignores the error and updates UI to show A.txt in Archive. On server refetch, A.txt is still in Documents.

evidence.dom: UI displays file moved to Archive

bugs.verification_method: Move A.txt to Archive -> Observe 500 PUT response -> Observe UI shows file moved -> Query Documents via GET /api/files?folderId=folder-documents -> Verify A.txt still in Documents.
